text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown's quarterly table gives a total development budget of $1,700,000 across Q1 to Q4 2027.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Total | $1,700,000 | $460,000 | $240,000 | $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The quarterly development amounts are $450,000, $500,000, $400,000 and $350,000, which sum to $1,700,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q1 2027 | $450,000 | $120,000 | $60,000 | $630,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q2 2027 | $500,000 | $150,000 | $70,000 | $720,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q3 2027 | $400,000 | $100,000 | $60,000 | $560,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q4 2027 | $350,000 | $90,000 | $50,000 | $490,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown says these figures reflect the originally approved budget.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown also states that the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 after a December 2026 revision to cover additional smart TV integration costs.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The documents don't say how the adjusted total is split by category or quarter, so they don't give a revised development figure.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":["The documents don't give a revised development budget after the adjustment."],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
